# Git Standards

Generate code suitable for Git review.

## Commits

Follow Conventional Commits.

Examples

feat:

fix:

refactor:

test:

docs:

style:

perf:

## Refactoring

When refactoring:

- Preserve functionality.
- Do not introduce breaking changes.
- Keep commits focused.

## Pull Requests

Generated code should:

- Compile
- Pass tests
- Follow project standards

## Code Review

Always check for:

- Bugs
- Security
- Performance
- Readability
- SOLID
- PSR-12
- Duplicate code
